pitch.text: Meet Ordo, the AI maintenance engineer for your codebase, built on IBM Bob 2.0.

Technical debt grows quietly. It piles up unseen, until it becomes an outage, slow delivery, or a security incident. Today's scanners produce long, noisy reports, ranked by rule severity, with no business context and no fix path. So the list gets ignored.
Ordo closes that gap. IBM Bob 2.0 scans the repository and detects the debt, watsonx dot AI ranks it by real risk, and Ordo hands your team the fix.
Bob runs the scan and detects every issue. Then IBM watsonx dot AI scores each one for urgency, impact, and effort, and explains why. Let's see it live.

demo.text: This is Ordo's web app, running on Vercel. We'll scan a real project, Agora, straight from GitHub.
I click Scan Repo Now and paste the repository link. Bob takes over, reading the code through the GitHub API and running five debt detectors, live.
Seconds later, Ordo's dashboard. Bob detected twenty issues, and watsonx ranked all of them high urgency, scoring each for urgency, impact, and effort.
The overview breaks the debt down by category, shows repository stats, including zero test files, and lists the top issues.
watsonx then writes the roadmap. An overall assessment, then three phases the team can schedule.
Open any issue to drill in. Ask why it is ranked here, and watsonx explains its reasoning in plain English.
Then generate the fix. watsonx writes a step by step remediation plan, code hints, a testing strategy, and a pull request summary, and Ordo lets you copy it straight into GitHub with one click.
Under the hood, Ordo is a custom IBM Bob 2.0 mode with three skills. Bob runs the scan and detects the debt. watsonx dot AI does the scoring and the writing.
And the full pitch deck is one click away, under Docs.

close.text: Ordo, built on IBM Bob 2.0 with watsonx dot AI, turns software chaos into order. Try it today at ordo with bob dot vercel dot app.
